summary: Ciena Corp filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $2.875B private offering of 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031. Proceeds were used to repurchase ~$140M of common stock at $466.67/share, repay $1.14B of its senior secured term loan, and fund general corporate purposes. The notes convert at ~$746.66/share. The filing reflects a leveraged recapitalization returning capital to shareholders through buybacks and debt reduction. Watch for dilution risk from conversion and impact on leverage ratios.
